title: AICP Audit Event
description: A normalized audit record for traceable Card action, authorization decisions, phase transitions, and governance events in the Agent Identity Card Protocol.

id.description: Platform-issued unique identifier for this audit event

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred

actor_card_id.description: Card identity under which the action occurred

operator_id.description: Authenticated operator account from which authority was delegated

human_principal_id.description: Human principal or organization ultimately accountable for the operator account, when available

agreement_id.description: Agreement associated with the event, if applicable

tool_name.description: Tool invoked or denied, if applicable

authorization_scope.description: OAuth or platform scope evaluated for this action

credential_id.description: Identifier for the token, credential, or session used, if recorded by the platform

decision.description: Authorization or recording decision associated with the event

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for the decision or state change

correlation_id.description: Request, trace, or workflow correlation identifier for joining related events
